name: Japanese Black Wagyu (American)
notes: AWA publishes EPDs for Fullblood, Purebred, and percentage Wagyu (F1-F3). EPDs are on the USDA marbling scale.

traits.label: Calving Ease Direct
traits.description: Expected % unassisted births from the sire to first-calf heifers, expressed as a difference from breed average.

traits.label: Birth Weight
traits.description: Expected progeny difference in birth weight. Lower values favored for heifer bulls.

traits.label: Weaning Weight
traits.description: Progeny weight difference at ~205 days of age.

traits.label: Yearling Weight
traits.description: Progeny weight difference at ~365 days of age.

traits.label: Maternal Milk
traits.description: Weaning weight contribution from the daughter's milk production.

traits.label: Total Maternal
traits.description: (WW / 2) + Milk — combined growth and milk of daughters.

traits.label: Carcass Weight
traits.description: Progeny hot carcass weight difference at harvest.

traits.label: Marbling (USDA)
traits.description: USDA marbling score difference — the defining Wagyu trait.

traits.label: Fat Thickness
traits.description: 12th rib backfat. Lower values favored — excess fat is trimmed.

traits.label: Intramuscular Fat %
traits.description: Ultrasound-measured intramuscular fat percentage — correlates to marbling.

traits.label: Yield Grade
traits.description: USDA yield grade. Lower = higher cutability.

indexes.label: Grid Value
indexes.description: Expected carcass grid premium based on marbling, ribeye, and yield grade.
